asset_ownership_interpretation: JBank markets the protocol as decentralized and self-custodial, but staking necessarily places assets under smart-contract/protocol rules and the 4 December 2025 International Version notice says affected long-term staked assets are transferred into that system for management. The reviewed public material does not establish a conventional segregated-deposit structure or an unconditional right to immediate withdrawal while assets are subject to long-term staking or International Version release rules.
notes: The issuer-described release paths are six-month delayed release or performance-based accelerated unlocking, with no static returns during those periods. CYA does not treat self-custody marketing, guaranteed-return wording, POL reserves or protocol mechanics as a legal principal guarantee. JUC/JUB token continuity remains unresolved.
